entries.text: The UAT now connects Databend to the published self-hosted endpoint with the compose password instead of failing configuration in two seconds.

Doris sessions concatenate with ||, translate backtick-quoted and CREATE TABLE AS DDL with the single-replica property, create updatable staging tables with the unique key model, run explicit transactions with BEGIN and numbers(), and skip the Write and Transaction Primitives operations whose Doris errors are cited; Read Primitives and TPC-H Havoc have Doris variants for window frames, full-text, ASOF, named windows and aliased ORDER BY.
Staging manifest tables left by Write Primitives no longer block Transaction Primitives from replacing a shared database.
